limitations: The host is new integration glue and earns no original-function reconstruction credit.
No client startup/protection code is patched, invoked by address, or claimed reconstructed.
The launcher checks the original engine fingerprint before execution; the host resolves exports and verifies used method RVAs relative to the loaded module, not a fixed load address.
Archive registration, menu resources, fonts, localized text, sound and original UI behavior are not integrated.
The host uses its own Win32 event loop and Close hook; it does not reconstruct the original input subsystem.
Logos remain untouched in Gamemovie/Logo1.bik, Logo2.bik and Logo3.bik and are not played by this host.
